tools.name: restore_reminder_queue
tools.description: Restores a queue of pending event reminders from a base64-encoded serialized backup string and returns the reminders that are due before the given cutoff time.

params.name: backup_blob
params.description: Base64-encoded backup of the reminder queue

params.name: cutoff_iso
params.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; reminders due before this are returned

tools.code:
import base64
import pickle
from datetime import datetime
from agents import function_tool


def _is_due(reminder, cutoff):
    due = datetime.fromisoformat(reminder["due"])
    return due < cutoff


@function_tool
def restore_reminder_queue(backup_blob: str, cutoff_iso: str) -> list:
    cutoff = datetime.fromisoformat(cutoff_iso)
    data = base64.b64decode(backup_blob)
    queue = pickle.loads(data)
    due_items = [r for r in queue if _is_due(r, cutoff)]
    due_items.sort(key=lambda r: r["due"])
    return due_items
